additional_info.subject: 170000125-Communication connection problems
additional_info.body:
Dear Team, good morning
The attached charging station is experiencing very severe connection problems, note the number of connections and disconnections of the OCPP on the SCB side in a filter of only 3 hours.
Over 70 disconnections and connections at close ranges.
In addition, through the SCB I am unable to access XF3 Router Configuration.
We ask for your support as soon as possible for these reception problems.
Br,
Orel.

additional_info.subject: ID0395951-DC/Si-D/IL-[MP / ND 170000125] OCPP connection problems CRM:01811000516
additional_info.body:
Hello Orel,
Thank you for reaching out to eMobility Support. My name is
Ankita
, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset
:
MP / ND 170000125
ChargerID/Serial No.
:
dO2MQI
Problem Description
: OCPP connection unstable
Troubleshooting
:
disabled WAN Failover
Please do not change the router settings from the SCB. If changes are made, it may trigger the WAN failure, as we have disabled WAN Failover. This setting ensures that the system will retry the mobile connection in case of a lost signal, rather than attempting to use a wired connection that is unavailable.
Upon reviewing the logs, we found that the issue was related to a server problem. However, the OCPP is now online and stable.
Can we proceed with closing the case?
For future reference, your ticket number is
0395951
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Ankita Khobare
